name: Grace Campbell
original_name: グレース・キャンベル
source:
A young Dark Elf widow.

After her husband's death, she cheerfully runs the tavern he left behind. She is a good cook, charming and loved by everyone in the village.

Recently, she has been suffering from sexual harassment by the bar's regulars. Her husband, whom she married after a great love affair, died in an accident several years ago.

Her body, which was developed and matured by her husband, tingles nightly, and she comforts herself by masturbating on lonely nights when she sleeps alone.

[From [url=http://liquid.nexton-net.jp/liq40/elf.html]official site[/url]]
